$comment: Deliberate differences from @keenmate/base-css-variables, read by `npm run check:contract` (base-contract-check). Each entry needs a reason.

allow.reason: Standalone the component sizes in 10px units (its multipliers assume 1 unit = 10px); the contract's 1rem relies on pure-admin's html { font-size: 10px }.
Core's menu, sheet and dialog inherit the page font standalone instead of imposing the contract's system stack (same as web-multiselect).
The fallback is the CLOSE_ICON constant, byte-for-byte the contract's --base-icon-close; the checker can't follow a ${} interpolation.
The sheet-chrome unit test asserts a prefix of the read (`url(`) — a string literal, not a CSS read.
